title: Ancient rocks from the Moon’s far side rewrite the Solar System’s violent past
caption:
New samples from the lunar far side are challenging everything we thought we knew about the early Solar System. Instead of a single 'Late Heavy Bombardment,' it looks like asteroid impacts declined gradually over billions of years.

Source: Sciencedaily - Ancient rocks from the Moon’s far side rewrite the Solar System’s violent past
